e.title: **一份**把**智利寿险市场**做成**端到端 **BI 项目**、**并**把**数据的**合成性质**与**六条方法学限制**逐字写出的**作品集****：`chile-life-insurance-market-bi`——**⭐ 逐字自述**「**Proyecto end-to-end de Business Intelligence con datos 100 % sintéticos, inspirado en conceptos e indicadores del mercado asegurador chileno.**」**；**⭐ 数据规模逐字为**144 个观测、**12 家**虚构公司、**12 个季度**（**2023-T1 至 **2025-T4）、**39 个**原始变量****；**⭐ 控制值逐字到**2025-T4** 的**直接保费 **`2.435.934 MM CLP`** 与**加权赔付率 **`55,70 %`****；**⭐ 限制逐字含**「**la solvencia sintética es un indicador educativo y no reproduce la metodología regulatoria oficial de la CMF**」**
e.title_en: An end-to-end business intelligence project on the Chilean life insurance market that writes out both the synthetic nature of its data and six methodological limits: it describes itself in writing as an end-to-end business intelligence project using wholly synthetic data inspired by concepts and indicators of the Chilean insurance market, works on a panel of one hundred forty-four observations covering twelve fictional companies over twelve quarters with thirty-nine original variables, publishes control values down to direct premium and weighted loss ratio for the latest quarter, and states in writing that its synthetic solvency figure is an educational indicator that does not reproduce the regulator official methodology.
e.title_hk: **一份**把**智利壽險市場**做成**端到端 BI 項目**、**並**把**數據的**合成性質**與**六條方法學限制**逐字寫出的**作品集****：`chile-life-insurance-market-bi`——**⭐ 逐字自述**「**Proyecto end-to-end de Business Intelligence con datos 100 % sintéticos, inspirado en conceptos e indicadores del mercado asegurador chileno.**」**；**⭐ 數據規模逐字為**144 個觀測、**12 家**虛構公司、**12 個季度**（**2023-T1 至 2025-T4）、**39 個**原始變量****；**⭐ 控制值逐字到**2025-T4** 的**直接保費 `2.435.934 MM CLP`** 與**加權賠付率 `55,70 %`****；**⭐ 限制逐字含**「**la solvencia sintética es un indicador educativo y no reproduce la metodología regulatoria oficial de la CMF**」**
e.summary: **Análisis del Mercado Chileno de Seguros de Vida**（`JuanIgnacioPal/analisis-mercado-seguros-vida-chile`）**是一份**智利寿险市场的**端到端 **BI 项目****——**逐字自述为**「**Proyecto end-to-end de Business Intelligence con datos 100 % sintéticos, inspirado en conceptos e indicadores del mercado asegurador chileno.**」**。**本次实测**：**⭐ 创建 **2026-07-20T12:03:30Z****、**最后推送 **2026-09-11T03:41:58Z****、**仓库 **87,033 KB****、**主语言逐字为 **`Power Query`****、**星标 **0****、**⚠️ 无许可证****、**默认分支 **`main`****；**⭐ README **18,150 字节**／**394 行**（**另有英文摘要与英文版 README）**。**⭐⭐ 本条目属于本轮主题**「**把此前各轮记为「**待评**」的条目**逐条判定**」**，**并**补上**本站**最薄的一栏**——**人寿保险**（**实测**本轮**之前**该栏 **19 条**）**。**⭐⭐⭐ 四处最值得看**：**① **限制**写得**比结论**还**细****——**六条**逐字**含**「**ROE 因**合成数据的**合理性限制**被**排除在**主要结论之外**」**、**「**合成偿付能力**是**教育性指标**、**不**复现 **CMF** 官方**监管方法**」**、**「**净组合余额**与**存量变动**不**完全**对账**，**故****不**解释为**流失、**留存或**续保率**」**；**② **SQL 被当作**控制层**，**先**给出一张**2025-T4** 的**控制值表****（**直接保费、**环比、**同比、**加权赔付率、**费用率、**技术结果、**技术利润率、**合成偿付能力、**有效被保人数）**；**③ **执行建议**逐字**反对**「**一个分数**」**（**逐字**：**Evaluar eficiencia técnica y fortaleza de capital por separado, evitando un score único con ponderaciones arbitrarias**）**；**④ ⚠️ **一处**内部不一致**被**本词条**如实指出**：**英文摘要逐字称**「**examining the Chilean life insurance market using public CMF data**」**，**而**正文与**限制**逐字**写的是 **100 % synthetic****。**⚠️ 本次**未运行**其 **SQL** 或 **Power BI** 模型**。
e.summary_hk: **Análisis del Mercado Chileno de Seguros de Vida**（`JuanIgnacioPal/analisis-mercado-seguros-vida-chile`）**是一份**智利壽險市場的**端到端 BI 項目****——**逐字自述為**「**Proyecto end-to-end de Business Intelligence con datos 100 % sintéticos, inspirado en conceptos e indicadores del mercado asegurador chileno.**」**。**本次實測**：**⭐ 創建 2026-07-20T12:03:30Z**、**最後推送 2026-09-11T03:41:58Z**、**倉庫 87,033 KB**、**主語言逐字為 `Power Query`**、**星標 0**、**⚠️ 無許可證**、**默認分支 `main`**；**⭐ README 18,150 位元組／394 行**。**⭐⭐ 本條目屬於本輪主題**「**把此前各輪記為「**待評**」的條目**逐條判定**」**，**並補上**本站最薄的一欄**——**人壽保險**（**本輪之前該欄 19 條**）**。**⭐⭐⭐ 四處最值得看**：**① **限制寫得比結論還細****——**六條逐字含**「**ROE 因合成數據的合理性限制被排除在主要結論之外**」**、**「**合成償付能力是教育性指標、**不復現 CMF 官方監管方法**」**、**「**淨組合餘額與存量變動不完全對賬**，**故不**解釋為流失、**留存或續保率**」**；**② **SQL 當作控制層**，**先給出 2025-T4 控制值表**（**直接保費、**環比、**同比、**加權賠付率、**費用率、**技術結果、**技術利潤率、**合成償付能力、**有效被保人數**）**；**③ **執行建議逐字反對「**一個分數**」**（**逐字**Evaluar eficiencia técnica y fortaleza de capital por separado, evitando un score único con ponderaciones arbitrarias**）**；**④ ⚠️ **一處內部不一致****：**英文摘要逐字稱 using public CMF data**，**而正文與限制逐字寫的是 100 % synthetic**。**⚠️ 本次**未運行**其 SQL 或 Power BI 模型**。
e.summary_en: This is an end-to-end business intelligence project on the Chilean life insurance market, describing itself in writing as a project built on wholly synthetic data inspired by the concepts and indicators of that market. **Measured this round**: created in July and last pushed on the eleventh of September, a repository of about eighty-seven megabytes whose stated language is a spreadsheet query language, no stars, no licence file, a main branch, and a description of about eighteen kilobytes over three hundred ninety-four lines. **This entry belongs to the round theme of adjudicating the items earlier rounds had parked for review, and it fills the thinnest category on the site, life insurance, which held nineteen entries before this round.** **Four things are worth reading: the limitations are written in more detail than the conclusions, six of them stating that return on equity was excluded from the main conclusions because of a plausibility limit in the synthetic data, that the synthetic solvency figure is an educational indicator which does not reproduce the regulator official methodology, and that the net portfolio balance does not fully reconcile with the change in the stock of policyholders and is therefore not interpreted as churn, retention, or persistence; structured query language is used as a control layer before visualisation, with a published table of control values for the latest quarter covering direct premium, quarter-on-quarter and year-on-year growth, weighted loss ratio, expense ratio, technical result, technical margin, synthetic solvency, and policyholders in force; the executive recommendations argue in writing against a single score, urging that technical efficiency and capital strength be evaluated separately rather than merged with arbitrary weights; and this entry notes one internal inconsistency, since the English summary describes the project as examining the market using public regulator data while the body and the limitations state that the data are wholly synthetic.** **Neither its queries nor its dashboard model were run this round.**
e.body:
**Análisis del Mercado Chileno de Seguros de Vida**（`JuanIgnacioPal/analisis-mercado-seguros-vida-chile`）**是一份**智利寿险市场的**端到端 **BI 项目****——**逐字自述为**「**Proyecto end-to-end de Business Intelligence con datos 100 % sintéticos, inspirado en conceptos e indicadores del mercado asegurador chileno.**」**。**⭐ 本条目属于本轮主题**「**把此前各轮记为「**待评**」的条目**逐条判定**」**。

**可核实信息（均 2026-09-11 GitHub 接口与 README 实测）**：

**⭐⭐⭐ ① 限制写得比结论还细，**而**这**正是**本条**最值得记**的地方****——**⭐ 本次实测**：**README 有**专门一节**「**Limitaciones metodológicas**」**（**方法学限制）**，**逐条**包括**：**① **数据与公司**100 % 合成**，**仅**用于**教育与**作品集**；**② **ROE** 因**合成数据的**合理性限制**被**排除**在**主要结论之外**；**③ **合成偿付能力**是**教育性指标**，**并逐字**「**no reproduce la metodología regulatoria oficial de la CMF**」（**不**复现 **CMF** 官方**监管方法）**；**④ **「**净组合余额＝新被保人−注销**」**与**存量变动**不**完全对账**，**故**逐字**「**no se interpretan como churn, retención o persistencia**」（**不**解释为**流失、**留存或**续保率**）**；**⑤ **直接保费**与**分产品保费之和**存在**四舍五入差异**；**⑥ **赔付率、**费用与**技术利润率**之间**的**关系**因**构造公式**而**部分**机械**；**⭐ 本词条认为**这一节**是**整份作品**里**最**有价值**的**部分**：**⭐ 即**它**把**「**这份**数据**不**能**回答**什么**」**写在**结论**旁边**——**⭐ 对 RIAA**：**任何**用**合成或**脱敏**数据的**分析**，**都**应**列出**同一张**清单**（**哪个**指标**被**剔除、**哪条**因果**是**构造**出来的、**哪组**数字**对不上账**）**。

**⭐⭐ ② SQL 当控制层，**先给**控制值**表****——**⭐ 本次实测**：**README 逐字写**「**SQL se utilizó como capa de control antes de construir la visualización.**」**，**并逐字列出**2025-T4** 的**控制值**：**直接保费 **`2.435.934 MM CLP`**、**环比 **`4,77 %`**、**同比 **`4,29 %`**、**加权赔付率 **`55,70 %`**、**费用率 **`12,79 %`**、**技术结果 **`736.330 MM CLP`**、**技术利润率 **`31,51 %`**、**合成偿付能力 **`180,48 %`**、**有效被保人 **`9.134.304`**、**被保人同比 **`-3,83 %`****；**⭐ 本词条认为**这一做法**对**数据**工作**很**实用**：**⭐ 即**先**在**查询层**把**关键指标**固定成**可**比对的**控制值**，**再**做**可视化**——**⭐ 这样**当**报表**与**查询**不一致**时**，**先**怀疑**报表**，**而**不**是**先**怀疑**数据**。

**⭐⭐ ③ 数据规模与结构**逐字**可核****——**⭐ 本次实测**：**数据集逐字为**144 个观测**、**12 家**虚构寿险公司、**12 个季度**（**2023-T1 至 **2025-T4）、**39 个**原始变量**、**性质逐字 **`100 % sintéticos`****；**变量**覆盖**财务、**商业、**运营、**资本、**组合与**产品结构****；**⭐ 并逐字提供**数据字典、**KPI 字典、**SQL 方法学**与**数据质量审计**四份**文档**；**⭐ 维度模型**逐字**含**维度表**与**事实表**，**并**给出**2025-T4** 的**主要对账**。

**⭐⭐ ④ 执行建议**方向**明确**，**且**反对**「**一个分数**」****——**⭐ 本次实测**：**README 逐字列出**五条**建议**，**其中**两条**对本站读者**尤其**值得抄**：**逐字**「**Evaluar eficiencia técnica y fortaleza de capital por separado, evitando un score único con ponderaciones arbitrarias.**」（**把**技术效率与**资本实力**分开评估**，**避免**用**任意权重**合成**一个**分数）**；**逐字**「**Implementar conciliaciones stock–flujo de cartera antes de utilizar altas y cancelaciones como base para métricas de churn, retención o persistencia.**」（**在**把**新增与**注销**当作**流失／**留存／**续保**指标的**基础之前**，**先**做**存量与**流量的**对账）**；**⭐ 本词条认为**这两条**是**本轮的**可迁移**结论**：**⭐ 即**「**先对账，**再算比率**」**与**「**不要**把**不同性质**的**强度**强行**合成**一个**分数**」。

**⭐⭐ ⑤ ⚠️ 一处**内部不一致**（**本词条**如实指出）****——**⭐ 本次实测**：**README 的**英文摘要**逐字写**「**Data analytics portfolio project examining the Chilean life insurance market using public CMF data.**」**（**使用**公开的 **CMF** 数据）**，**而**正文**数据集**一节**与**方法学限制**逐字**写的是 **100 % sintéticos****；**⭐ 本词条**不**猜测**其**原因**，**只**如实**指出**：**⭐ 即**当**一份**作品**同时**面向**西班牙语与**英语**读者**时**，**两个**版本的**口径**（**尤其**是**数据**性质**）**必须**一致**——**⭐ 这**也**是**为什么**本词条**把**数据**性质**单独**列出**。

**⭐⭐ ⑥ 与池内条目的关系**：**本站 [[cmf-chile]] 是**同一国**监管机构**的**统计入口**、**[[insurance-analytical-case-studies]] 覆盖**保险**分析案例**、**[[insurance-portfolio-performance]] 覆盖**组合**绩效**——**⭐ 而**本条补上的是**「**以**合成面板 + **SQL 控制层 + **维度模型**的**端到端**作品**、**并**把**数据**局限**写清**」这一形态**；**⭐ 本词条**不对以上任何一条做代码级比较**。

**对 RIAA**：**⭐ 六件事值得借**：**① **限制清单**要**逐条**写**，**并**放在**结论**旁边**；**② **先**定**控制值**，**再**做**可视化**；**③ **对账**不成立**时**，**不要**用**该差额**算**比率**；**④ **不要**用**任意权重**合成**单一**分数**；**⑤ **合成数据**要**写明**哪些**指标**因此**不可用**（**本条**剔除 **ROE）**；**⑥ **多语言**版本**的**口径**必须**一致**。

**⚠️ 本词条如实标注**：**① ⚠️⚠️⚠️ 本次**没有运行**其 **SQL** 查询、**没有打开**其 **Power BI** 模型**（**未下载**其数据集**）**，**故**不主张**其**任何指标**的**计算**正确性**。**② ⚠️ 本次**只读**仓库接口返回的元数据**与 **README 文本**，**未读**其 **`.pbix` 模型**、**未读**其 **SQL 脚本**与**四份**文档**。**③ ⚠️ **未核实**其**合成数据**的**生成方法**（**⭐ 逐字**只**说明**为**合成**，**未**给出**生成**过程**）**。**④ ⚠️ **未核实**其**控制值**与**合成数据集**是否**一致**（**⭐ 本次**未下载**数据**）**。**⑤ ⚠️ **未核实**其**是否为**任何**课程**或**机构**的**项目**（**⭐ 逐字**含**课程式**表述**与**作品集**定位**）**。**⑥ ⚠️ 该仓库**无许可证文件**（**接口 `license` 字段为空**）**。**⑦ ⚠️ 本条目**所记为 **2026-09-11 所见**；**⚠️ 该作品**是**教学**与**作品集**项目**，**其**数字**不**代表**智利**寿险市场**的**真实**表现**，**也**不是**精算意见**。
e.body_hk:
**Análisis del Mercado Chileno de Seguros de Vida**（`JuanIgnacioPal/analisis-mercado-seguros-vida-chile`）**是一份**智利壽險市場的**端到端 BI 項目****——**逐字自述為**「**Proyecto end-to-end de Business Intelligence con datos 100 % sintéticos, inspirado en conceptos e indicadores del mercado asegurador chileno.**」**。**⭐ 本條目屬於本輪主題**「**把此前各輪記為「**待評**」的條目**逐條判定**」**。

**可核實資訊（均 2026-09-11 GitHub 介面與 README 實測）**：

**⭐⭐⭐ ① 限制寫得比結論還細****——**方法學限制逐條含**：**數據與公司 100 % 合成（**僅**用於**教育與**作品集）**；**ROE 因合成數據的合理性限制被排除在主要結論之外**；**合成償付能力逐字**「**no reproduce la metodología regulatoria oficial de la CMF**」**；**「**淨組合餘額＝新被保人−註銷**」**與存量變動不完全對賬**，**逐字**「**no se interpretan como churn, retención o persistencia**」**；**四捨五入差異**；**部分關係因構造公式而機械**；**⭐ 即**把「**這份數據不能回答什麼**」寫在結論旁邊**。

**⭐⭐ ② SQL 當控制層****——**逐字**「**SQL se utilizó como capa de control antes de construir la visualización.**」**；**2025-T4 控制值逐字為**`2.435.934 MM CLP`、**環比 `4,77 %`、**同比 `4,29 %`、**加權賠付率 `55,70 %`、**費用率 `12,79 %`、**技術結果 `736.330 MM CLP`、**技術利潤率 `31,51 %`、**合成償付能力 `180,48 %`、**有效被保人 `9.134.304`、**被保人同比 `-3,83 %`**。

**⭐⭐ ③ 數據規模與結構****——**144 個觀測、**12 家虛構壽險公司、**12 個季度（**2023-T1 至 2025-T4）、**39 個原始變量、**性質逐字 `100 % sintéticos`**；**另附**數據字典、**KPI 字典、**SQL 方法學**與**數據質量審計****。

**⭐⭐ ④ 執行建議反對「一個分數」****——**逐字**Evaluar eficiencia técnica y fortaleza de capital por separado, evitando un score único con ponderaciones arbitrarias.** 與 **Implementar conciliaciones stock–flujo de cartera antes de utilizar altas y cancelaciones como base para métricas de churn, retención o persistencia.**；**⭐ 即**先對賬、**再算比率**。

**⭐⭐ ⑤ ⚠️ 一處內部不一致****——**英文摘要逐字**using public CMF data**，**而正文與限制逐字為 `100 % sintéticos`**；**本條不猜原因**，**只指出多語言版本口徑必須一致**。

**⭐⭐ ⑥ 與池內條目的關係**：[[cmf-chile]]、[[insurance-analytical-case-studies]]、[[insurance-portfolio-performance]]——**⭐ 本條補上的是**「**合成面板＋**SQL 控制層＋**維度模型**的端到端作品**」**這一形態**。

**對 RIAA**：**⭐ 六件事值得借**：**① **限制清單逐條寫並放在結論旁邊**；**② **先定控制值再做可視化**；**③ **對賬不成立時不要用差額算比率**；**④ **不要以任意權重合成分數**；**⑤ **合成數據要寫明哪些指標因此不可用**；**⑥ **多語言版本口徑一致**。

**⚠️ 本詞條如實標註**：**① ⚠️⚠️⚠️ 本次**沒有運行**其 SQL 查詢、**沒有打開**其 Power BI 模型**，**不主張**其任何指標的計算正確性**。**② ⚠️ 本次**只讀元資料與 README 文本**，**未讀**其模型、**SQL 腳本與四份文檔**。**③ ⚠️ **未核實**其合成數據的生成方法**。**④ ⚠️ **未核實**其控制值與合成數據集是否一致**（**本次未下載數據**）**。**⑤ ⚠️ **未核實**其是否為任何課程或機構的項目**。**⑥ ⚠️ 該倉庫無許可證檔案**。**⑦ ⚠️ 本條目所記為 2026-09-11 所見**；**⚠️ 該作品是教學與作品集項目**，**其數字不代表智利壽險市場的真實表現**，**也**不是**精算意見**。
e.body_en:
This is an end-to-end business intelligence project on the Chilean life insurance market, stating in writing that it uses wholly synthetic data inspired by the concepts and indicators of that market. **This entry belongs to the round theme of adjudicating the items earlier rounds had parked for review.**

**Verified information, all measured on 2026-09-11 from the repository interface and the description**:

**First, the limitations are written in more detail than the conclusions, and that is the most valuable part of the work.** A dedicated section lists them one by one: the data and the companies are wholly synthetic and used only for education and portfolio purposes; return on equity was excluded from the main conclusions because of a plausibility limitation of the synthetic dataset; the synthetic solvency figure is an educational indicator that does not reproduce the regulator official methodology, stated in writing; the identity defining net portfolio balance as new insureds minus cancellations does not fully reconcile with the change in the stock of policyholders, so those flows are not interpreted as churn, retention, or persistence; direct premium and the sum of premiums by product differ by rounding inherent to synthetic construction; and the relationships among loss ratio, expenses, and technical margin are partly mechanical because of the formula used to build the technical result. **Putting the list of what the data cannot answer next to the conclusions is exactly what any analysis built on synthetic or de-identified data should do, naming which measure was dropped, which relationship is an artefact of construction, and which figures do not reconcile.**

**Second, queries are used as a control layer and control values are published first.** The description states that structured queries were used as a control layer before the visualisation was built, and lists control values for the latest quarter: direct premium, quarter-on-quarter and year-on-year growth, weighted loss ratio, expense ratio, technical result, technical margin, synthetic solvency, policyholders in force, and their year-on-year change. **Fixing key measures as comparable control values in the query layer before building a dashboard means that when a report and a query disagree, the report is suspected first rather than the data.**

**Third, the scale and structure of the data are checkable.** The dataset is stated as one hundred forty-four observations across twelve fictional life insurers and twelve quarters with thirty-nine original variables, described as wholly synthetic, covering financial, commercial, operational, capital, portfolio, and product-mix variables, and accompanied by a data dictionary, a measure dictionary, a query methodology, and a data quality audit. **A dimensional model with dimension and fact tables and a published main reconciliation for the latest quarter completes the chain from raw file to dashboard.**

**Fourth, the recommendations take a clear direction and argue against a single score.** Two of the five are especially transferable: evaluating technical efficiency and capital strength separately rather than merging them into one score with arbitrary weights, and implementing portfolio stock-and-flow reconciliations before using additions and cancellations as the basis for churn, retention, or persistence measures. **Reconcile first and compute ratios second, and do not force intensities of different natures into a single number.**

**Fifth, this entry notes one internal inconsistency.** The English summary describes the project as examining the market using public regulator data, while the data section and the limitations state that the data are wholly synthetic. **This entry does not speculate about the cause; it simply notes that when a work addresses both Spanish-speaking and English-speaking readers, the two versions must agree on the nature of the data, which is also why this entry records that nature separately.**

**Sixth, relative to existing entries**: pooled entries cover the same country regulator statistics portal, insurance analytical case studies, and portfolio performance, **while this entry supplies the form of an end-to-end work built from a synthetic panel with a query control layer and a dimensional model that writes its data limits out. This entry makes no code-level comparison against any of them.**

**For RIAA**: **six practices transfer: write the limitations one by one beside the conclusions; fix control values before visualising; never compute a ratio from a difference that does not reconcile; avoid arbitrary weights in a single score; state which measures synthetic data makes unusable, as this project does with return on equity; and keep multilingual versions consistent in their definitions.**

**Marked honestly by this entry**: **first, neither the queries nor the dashboard model were run**, no dataset was downloaded, **so no claim is made about the correctness of any computed measure**. **Second, only repository metadata and the description were read**, not the dashboard model, the query scripts, or the four accompanying documents. **Third, how the synthetic data were generated was not verified**, the description stating only that they are synthetic. **Fourth, whether the control values agree with the synthetic dataset was not verified**, the data not being downloaded. **Fifth, whether the project belongs to any course or institution was not verified**, the description carrying course-like wording and a portfolio positioning. **Sixth, the repository carries no licence file. Seventh, this entry records what was visible on 2026-09-11 and states plainly that the work is a teaching and portfolio project whose figures do not represent the real Chilean life market and are not an actuarial opinion.**
